title: SourceInventory
description: Canonical inventory for a cancer-buddy-organize run. It records each user-supplied source file, the adapter path used only to make it LLM-readable, the redacted MD sidecar generated by the LLM, and the source-file redaction/persist intent. Adapter output is provenance only and is never a clinical text source.

patient_dir.description: Absolute path to <patient_dir>. All relative paths below resolve under this directory.

source_id.description: Stable per-source id, e.g. s001. Used to join source_redaction_status.json.

original_path.description: Original user-supplied path or archive-relative path recorded for audit. May be absolute or logical; never used as an anchor.

mirror_path.description: Local staging mirror under patient_dir/10_原始文件/. This may be replaced by a redacted copy before persist.

bucket_path.description: Canonical bucket-relative source-file path after Phase2 classification. Null before classification or for isolated unrelated files.

sidecar_path.description: Bucket-relative redacted MD sidecar generated by LLM ingestion and co-located with the canonical source copy. The retired ocr/ prefix is invalid for final archives.

read_mode.description: How the LLM received the source content. In all modes the LLM, not a dumb OCR/parser, writes the final redacted MD.

adapter.description: Format adapter used only to make the source LLM-readable.

adapter_provenance.description: Short provenance such as decode_tool=sips;rotation=90 or pdftoppm pages=3. Temporary paths are allowed only as provenance, never as anchors.

persist.description: Whether this source file is selected for final archive/persist.

redaction_required.description: True when the source-file copy can carry plaintext PII and must pass source-file redaction before persist.

redaction_strategy.description: Planned source-file redaction path. Missing PDF/DOCX implementations must use blocked_unsupported rather than persisting plaintext.

redacted_path.description: Bucket-relative redacted source-file path when known.
